info.title: Educational Framework WebSocket Contract
info.description: Baseline real-time contract for FEAT-002 session events.

/ws/parent.description: Parental control STOMP over WebSocket endpoint. Connections require Authorization: Bearer <token> during handshake.

/topic/family/{familyId}/sessions.description: Family-scoped topic for server-to-client parental session events.

familyId.description: Authenticated family identifier from the opaque token.

/ws/game.description: Native game WebSocket endpoint. No Authorization header is required during handshake. Authentication is performed via an initial auth message after connection. Handshake sequence: connect → send auth → receive AUTH_ACK → send heartbeat/game_action. Connections that do not send a valid auth message within 15 seconds are closed.

GameClientMessage.name: GameClientMessage
GameClientMessage.description: Messages sent from the game client to the server.

oneOf.title: AuthMessage
oneOf.description: First message sent after connecting. Binds the WebSocket session to an active child session.

oneOf.title: HeartbeatMessage
oneOf.description: Sent periodically to keep the child session alive. Only valid after successful auth.

oneOf.title: GameActionMessage
oneOf.description: Placeholder for future game engine actions. Only valid after successful auth.

GAME_STATE_UPDATE.description: State restore payload sent to game clients after reconnect.

SESSION_EXPIRED.description: Child session expired because inactivity grace window was exceeded.

SESSION_INVALIDATED.description: Family session was revoked externally, usually after a PIN change.

CHILD_EXPELLED.description: Parent or admin explicitly expelled the child from the active session.

PARENT_BLOCK.description: Child is blocked by parental control and cannot reconnect until unblocked.

HEARTBEAT_ACK.description: Acknowledgement emitted by server after receiving heartbeat.

AUTH_ACK.description: WebSocket session successfully bound to an active child session after auth message.
